notes: Analysis is highly faithful to the H.R. 1687 (CLEAN Act) Engrossed-in-House source; 0 material issues. All substantive prose fields (summary, brief, top_lines[], sections[].items[], underreported[], gaps[], changes, likelihoodReason) decomposed and receipt-backed against the bill text; no divisions[] on this bill. Every figure (2 years/year, 75%, 25%, 30/30/10 days, section 107(g), Section 4(b)), direction (interval shortened, withhold-only-with-justification, shall-not-exceed), and named entity (Secretary of the Interior, Geothermal Steam Act of 1970, National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, resource management plan in effect for the State) appears verbatim in the source. The 'every 2 years -> every year' change is grounded in the amendment instruction itself ('striking ``2 years'' and inserting ``year''), so it is source-verifiable without the underlying 30 U.S.C. 1003(b) statute, which was not fetched (referencedSources: []). Four minor open rows, none material: (1) sponsor party / majority-House composition, (2) speculative opposition forecast, and (3) Senate-committee/60-vote procedural note in likelihoodReason are congress.gov metadata or analyst framing not present in the bill source; (4) the featured Westerman floor quote cannot be verified because no Congressional Record source is registered. One purely technical provision was not surfaced by the analysis and is not counted as a material omission: Sec. 2(a)(2) redesignates existing paragraphs (3) and (4) as (5) and (6) (renumbering only, zero reader impact).
